summary: Iteration 137 — Restaurant campaign end-to-end regression. Backend pytest 17/19 pass. Verified: GET rewards-campaign resolves main/restaurant/bogus->main correctly (id, vertical, name, enabled). /tenants default excludes restaurants (on_count 2, restaurants list=[Infinity]) and campaign=restaurant returns tenants=[Infinity], on=true, restaurants=[]. Flag POST works for both restaurant and salon tenants, on_count unchanged for salon after flag. Settlements: default has only miracurl-marathahalli & miracurl-whitefield; ?campaign=restaurant returns 1 row for infinity-family-restaurant status=not_set. Anomalies scoped to restaurant only. Guide PDF (restaurant) has 'Taste Ambassador' and no 'Brand Model'. Agreement PDF (main) still has 'Salon Participation Agreement'. Public: /public/rewards/infinity-family-restaurant returns Taste Ambassador campaign, vertical restaurant, salon_on=true, agreement_pending=true; /public/rewards/miracurl-marathahalli unchanged. Tenant regression (admin@miracurl.com): /api/settings/rewards-campaign returns Miracurl Customer Rewards – 2026 with settlement.amount=4000 and agreement obj; /agreement returns version str + share_pct=10. Frontend: /super-admin?tab=tenants renders BOTH rewards-campaign-card (Salons ON 2/7) and rewards-campaign-card-restaurant (Taste Ambassador, Infinity tile, no 'excluded' note); settlement-tracker + settlement-tracker-restaurant + settlement-row-infinity-family-restaurant present; rewards-cfg-toggle in restaurant card expands the settings form (verified via screenshot). FAILING: (a) PUT /api/super-admin/rewards-campaign?campaign=restaurant with tagline change did NOT persist tagline (returned original) — CampaignIn Pydantic model has no 'tagline' field so it is silently dropped. (b) Restaurant agreement.pdf still contains 'Brand Model' string — _acceptance_page in services/campaign_docs.py hardcodes 'Brand Model Campaign — Salon Participation Agreement' text OUTSIDE the _verticalise() replacement pass. (c) Public /rewards/infinity-family-restaurant page still contains 'Brand Model' wording and multiple 'salon' word occurrences outside footer — RewardsCampaign.jsx W() word-swap is not swapping restaurant vertical text consistently.

critical.issue: 'tagline' field is missing from CampaignIn Pydantic model (routes/rewards_campaign.py:136-153). Pydantic drops the field silently, so tagline can never be saved for either campaign. Reproduce: GET restaurant -> take body -> change tagline -> PUT -> response tagline == original.

PDF text contains 'Brand Model' (regression per spec). Root cause: services/campaign_docs.py::_acceptance_page (lines 167-170) hardcodes 'Brand Model Campaign — Salon Participation Agreement' text and is invoked AFTER _verticalise() has been applied to the main body only (build_agreement_pdf line 254). Fix: pass camp['vertical'] into _acceptance_page and swap wording, OR run its text through the same replacements as _verticalise.

integration_issues.issue: /rewards/infinity-family-restaurant body still contains 'Brand Model' and the word 'salon' appears in campaign copy (not only in the footer CTA). RewardsCampaign.jsx W() word-swap / setVertical is not intercepting all text nodes (likely campaign 'terms', 'tenant_terms', 'entry_rules' labels stored under the restaurant document still carry salon wording from defaults, and the swap is only applied to hard-coded strings in the JSX, not to server-supplied strings).

action_items: Add `tagline: str = Field('', max_length=200)` to CampaignIn in /app/backend/routes/rewards_campaign.py and include it in DEFAULT_CAMPAIGN so it round-trips through PUT.

Make services/campaign_docs.py::_acceptance_page vertical-aware: either apply the same (Brand Model->Taste Ambassador, Salon->Restaurant) replacements to its hardcoded intro/labels, or move that page's text through _verticalise().

In /app/frontend/src/pages/RewardsCampaign.jsx apply the vertical word-swap to server-supplied strings (campaign.terms, tenant_terms, entry_rules[].label, tagline, name) — currently the swap only covers static JSX text so 'Brand Model' and 'salon' from DB leak into the restaurant public page. Alternatively, the backend should verticalise these strings for restaurant campaigns before returning them from /api/public/rewards/{slug}.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rewards_campaign.py: CampaignIn (line 136) is a strict allow-list for PUT. It is missing `tagline` even though DEFAULT_RESTAURANT_CAMPAIGN.tagline exists. Any front-end form that lets HQ edit the tagline will appear to save but the change is dropped.

services/campaign_docs.py::_verticalise (line 222) is well-designed but only applied to the docs' section text, not to `_acceptance_page` which is rendered separately with hardcoded 'Salon' / 'Brand Model' strings. This is a maintenance trap — anyone editing the acceptance page later has to remember to add restaurant swaps.

routes/rewards_campaign.py::_pfilter (line 101) uses `campaign_id != 'restaurant'` for the main campaign. This is safe today but couples participant filtering to a magic string; a future third campaign (e.g. 'spa') would silently be counted as salon. Consider explicit membership by campaign_id.

frontend RewardsCampaign.jsx W() word-swap is presentational only — the same DB-sourced strings will also appear un-swapped in exports (share cards, emails, PDFs) unless the backend verticalises them. Prefer swapping at the API boundary.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (public restaurant page copy leaks salon wording)

rca of the issue: PUT tagline drop → Pydantic CampaignIn schema doesn't declare tagline, so `body.model_dump()` drops it before the Mongo upsert. Restaurant PDF 'Brand Model' leak → _acceptance_page hardcodes salon-language strings and is invoked after the _verticalise() replacements have already been applied to the main body dict; the acceptance page's own strings never get swapped. Frontend restaurant page leak → server returns restaurant campaign with salon-worded `terms`/`tenant_terms`/`entry_rules[].label` (originally copied from DEFAULT_CAMPAIGN via {**DEFAULT_CAMPAIGN, ...}), and RewardsCampaign.jsx W() only swaps static JSX strings, not server-supplied text, so 'Brand Model' and 'salon' render as-is on the public page.
